content.question: How do I post a project on Workzora?
content.answer: It's simple! Click the 'Post a Project' button, describe your requirements, set a budget, and start receiving bids from qualified freelancers within minutes.

content.question: Is it free to use the platform?
content.answer: Registration and posting projects are completely free. We only charge a small fee when you successfully award a project or complete a task.

content.question: How does the Milestone Payment system work?
content.answer: Milestone Payments protect both parties. The client deposits funds, which are held securely and only released to the freelancer once the specific project goals are met.

content.question: How can I choose the best freelancer for my job?
content.answer: You can review their portfolios, check their ratings, read feedback from previous clients, and even chat with them before making your final decision.

content.question: What if I'm not satisfied with the work?
content.answer: We encourage open communication through our chat. If an issue cannot be resolved, our dispute resolution team is here to help mediate and find a fair outcome.

content.question: Can I hire freelancers for long-term projects?
content.answer: Absolutely! Workzora is great for both quick one-off tasks and ongoing, long-term collaborations with dedicated experts.

content.question: Are the freelancers on Workzora verified?
content.answer: Yes, we have a verification process for our top talent to ensure identity and skill authenticity, helping you hire with confidence.

content.question: How do I get paid as a freelancer?
content.answer: Once a client releases a Milestone Payment, the funds are added to your Workzora balance. You can then withdraw them using your preferred payment method.

content.question: Can I work on the move?
content.answer: Yes! Use our mobile-friendly web interface or our app to chat with clients, manage your projects, and get real-time updates anywhere, anytime.

content.question: What categories of work are available?
content.answer: We have over 2700 categories, ranging from Web Design and Software Architecture to Content Writing, Logistics, and Legal services.

hireSection.title: Hire graphic designer
hireSection.cardText: On Workzora, you can hire a Graphic Artist to design a website, photoshop an image, theme your wordpress blog, typeset your annual report and more!
hireSection.whatIsText: Graphic design refers to the planning and projection of visual communication through the use of imagery, words, space, typography or fonts and color palettes. Graphic design is a critical element in the process of communication or product design and creation.

article.title: How to hire a great freelance

sections.intro: Frequently a company is critiqued based on its visual presence, often in advance of any business interaction.
sections.applicationsTitle: The application of graphic design is extensive and can encompass the following areas:
applications: Simple logos or various different types of logos
Promotional advertising such as posters, billboards or digital banners
Creating entire website design, the best homepage designs or individual graphical elements
sections.techIntro: In order to deliver a quality visual impact, and to exceed the brief of a client, a wide range of techniques are employed. If you are looking to translate your business idea into a logo, brand or other graphic design output then searching the global talent pool at Workzora is a great place to start. Workzora is home to highly talented graphic designers with a wide range of skills, located throughout the world.
sections.skillsTitle: Skills that are central to a successful graphic designer include:
skills: First class knowledge of design technology
Ability to interpret and deliver against a brief
sections.valueAdded: An operator simply following given instructions to implement a visual outcome is not considered a designer. A quality graphical expert should add incremental value to the creative process and production of effective visual communications, through increased sales, enhanced visual storytelling or eye-catching and memorable branding.
sections.software: Many graphic designers readily use traditional design methods such as sketches to explore creative territories or to garner client approval whilst minimizing time investment. Nevertheless, modern design experts are accomplished in a range of software applications, most of which hail from the Adobe Systems suite of products. Adobe Photoshop is a popular choice of photo editing software leveraged by a vast segment of designers. For the creation of vector-based drawings, Adobe Illustrator is a favored choice, and during the final stages of graphic production, Adobe InDesign is one of a number of page layout programs available. It is essential any graphic designer you employ is well versed in several of these design technologies.
sections.decision: Engaging a high-caliber graphic designer that is smart, creative and responsive is hands-down one of the most important decisions your business will make. A top class designer will ensure your brand, communications or products stand out from the crowd, clearly articulating messaging and imploring your audience to take action.
sections.market: The market is flooded with graphic designers. Some are highly talented. Some are not. The challenge is sourcing top design talent. At Workzora we make it easy for you. With a community of thousands of experienced graphic designers highly proficient in the popular Adobe product suite, alongside hundreds of other specialist design technologies, finding an expert for your graphic design job couldn't be simpler!
sections.hireNow: If you need a graphic designer to take your business or visual communications to the next level, then hire them through the community at Workzora. Post a project, and kickstart your next graphic design project today!

whatDoes.title: What does a Graphic Designer do?
whatDoes.text: Put simply, a Graphic Designer conveys ideas visually. From product packaging to concert posters to book covers, from the websites we surf to the billboards we see, from the ads we watch on TV to the menus we order from, graphic designers are used everywhere. They combine their artistic talent with their knowledge of design principles and their software skills to create effective designs for clients across all kinds of industries.

whyHire.title: Why should I hire a freelance Graphic Designer?
whyHire.text1: If a picture tells a thousand words, then you shouldn't rely on cookie-cutter designs to tell your story. With the help of professional Graphic Designers, you can create a powerful visual impact for your marketing campaigns and business communications. Freelance Graphic Designers have expertise in a variety of fields and can provide a wide range of services, from print to web media, based on your specific requirements. With their experience using Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator and other tools, they can help you develop your business's logo, business cards, website banners, social media images, and more.
whyHire.text2: Typically, you can hire professional freelance graphic designers on Workzora for anywhere between $5 and $100 per hour. It depends on the number of design assets, project complexity and the skill set needed to do the job. Location of the freelancer is also a significant factor. Having said that, Graphic Design is one of the most in-demand and competitive skills on Workzora, which means you can easily find high-quality designers within any budget range you may have.

rights.title: Do I own the rights to work completed by a freelance Graphic Designer?
rights.text: A graphic designer could try to claim ownership of work that they complete, especially if their designs are original designs that don't contain a lot of your original brand or company assets. However, you can avoid any confusion and retain full rights to any work the designer completes by upgrading your project with an IP Agreement that you and the designer can sign before the project starts. You can also ask freelancers to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), another upgrade, before working with them.

items.question: What is WorkZora?
items.answer: WorkZora is a Ukrainian freelance platform that connects clients and freelancers. All transactions are made in US dollars, while funds for each deal are held in an escrow vault — a secure platform account — until the work result is confirmed. Currently, the platform serves users from Ukraine. Expanding to other regions is the next step.

items.question: How is WorkZora different from other freelance marketplaces?
items.answer: The key difference is payments in USD and escrow protection by default. The platform uses escrow protection for every deal. WorkZora builds an infrastructure where both parties receive additional protection: the client does not pay for unfinished work, and the freelancer does not start without payment confirmation. WorkZora is currently in the MVP phase. We openly communicate this and continue to develop new features.

items.question: Is registration on the platform free?
items.answer: Yes. Registration is free for both parties. A commission is charged only for successfully completed deals — see the "Payments and Fees" section for details.

items.question: Is WorkZora available outside Ukraine?
items.answer: At the moment, the platform is focused on users from Ukraine. We plan to gradually expand the platform's geography. There are no specific dates yet.

items.question: How do I register on the platform?
items.answer: Go to workzora.com, click "Sign Up", and fill in your details: name, email, and password. After confirming your email, you will gain access to your personal dashboard. To fully use the platform — publish projects, top up your balance, and withdraw funds — account verification is required.

items.question: What is required for verification?
items.answer: WorkZora performs KYC (Know Your Customer) verification: identity confirmation using official documents. This is a standard procedure for platforms that handle financial transactions. Verification reduces the risk of fraud and increases trust between users.

items.question: How can a client post their first project?
items.answer: After registration and verification, go to the "Projects" section → "New Project". Describe the task, specify the budget in dollars, and indicate the desired deadlines. Publishing a project is free.

items.question: How can a freelancer find projects?
items.answer: Complete your profile: skills, description, portfolio, and rate. Browse the list of active projects and apply to those that match your specialization. Clients can view your profile and invite you to work.

items.question: What is escrow and how does it work on WorkZora?
items.answer: Escrow is a secure platform account where the client's funds are held while the deal is being completed. 1. The client confirms the deal — the funds are locked in the vault. 2. The freelancer sees that the money is reserved and starts working. 3. The client accepts the result — the funds are transferred to the freelancer's balance. Neither party can access the funds without fulfilling the deal terms.

items.question: What happens if the client does not confirm the result?
items.answer: If the client does not respond within the established period after the work is submitted, the deal may automatically be considered completed, or the freelancer may initiate a dispute. Specific deadlines are outlined in the Platform Rules.

items.question: Can a freelancer withdraw from a deal after work has started?
items.answer: Yes, but the procedure depends on the terms of the specific deal. If the work has not yet started or there are valid reasons, the deal may be canceled by mutual agreement. If a conflict arises, a dispute is opened.

items.question: Is it safe to keep funds on my WorkZora balance?
items.answer: We apply technical security measures and verify platform users. However, we recommend withdrawing earned funds in a timely manner — the platform balance is not a bank deposit.

items.question: What currency is used for payments?
items.answer: All deals, balances, and payouts are made in US dollars (USD). This helps avoid dependence on the hryvnia exchange rate and simplifies payments for both parties.

items.question: What is the platform fee?
items.answer: For clients: 0% fee for publishing a project. For freelancers: a commission is charged from the amount of a successfully completed deal. The rate depends on the profile rating and the order amount. No hidden fees. Current rates are always available in the "Pricing" section of your personal dashboard.

items.question: How do I top up my balance?
items.answer: Go to the "Finance" section in your personal dashboard and choose a top-up method. Available payment methods are displayed in your profile.

items.question: How do I withdraw funds?
items.answer: In the "Finance" section, select "Withdraw Funds". You can transfer funds to a bank card or a wallet of a supported payment system. In most cases, processing takes a few hours.

items.question: Is there a minimum withdrawal amount?
items.answer: You can find the latest information about the minimum withdrawal amount in the "Finance" section or contact support.

items.question: What should I do if I have a misunderstanding with the other party?
items.answer: First, try to resolve the issue directly through chat — most misunderstandings are settled at this stage. If you cannot reach an agreement, you can open a dispute through your personal dashboard.

items.question: How do I open a dispute?
items.answer: Go to the relevant deal and click "Open Dispute". Describe the situation and attach supporting materials: messages, files, screenshots, and project requirements. The more details you provide, the faster the team can review the case.

items.question: Who resolves disputes and how?
items.answer: The WorkZora team reviews the situation according to the platform rules: analyzing communication, the progress of the work, and whether the result meets the project requirements. The goal is to help both parties reach a fair solution. Conclusions are based on the provided materials and the circumstances of the specific case.

items.question: How long does dispute resolution take?
items.answer: The timeframe depends on the complexity of the case and the completeness of the provided materials. You can track the status of the case in your personal dashboard.

About.whyTitle: We know what freelancing looks like without protection
About.whyP1: You pay upfront and the freelancer disappears. Or vice versa: the work is delivered, but the client delays payment. This problem remains relevant for most market participants.
About.whyP2: WorkZora is built around escrow: the client's funds are locked until the result is approved. Freelancers see the funds secured before they start working. Clients receive the result first, and only then are the funds released. All transactions are made in USD — no exchange rate dependency and no currency conversion.
About.whyP3: WorkZora is the answer to a specific problem: how to make online collaboration in Ukraine safe and predictable for both sides.

About.clientStep2Text: Review profiles, ratings and prices — then invite someone to work.
About.clientStep3Text: Confirm the work and the escrow is released. Fees apply only to successful deals.
About.freelancerStep1Text: Add skills, portfolio and rates. Complete account verification.
About.freelancerStep2Text: See secured funds before starting work and focus on delivering results.
About.freelancerStep3Text: After approval, your balance is credited. In most cases withdrawals take only a few hours.
About.benefit1Text: Client funds are securely held and released only after the work is approved.
About.benefit2Text: Balance, deals and payouts are all in US dollars. No exchange rate dependency and no conversions.
About.benefit3Text: Fees apply only to successful deals. Project publishing is free. No hidden charges.
About.benefit4Text: Participant verification reduces fraud risks and increases trust on the platform.
About.benefit5Text: If a deal reaches a deadlock, the WorkZora team reviews the case according to platform rules and helps both parties find a solution.
About.benefit6Text: Our support team responds to user requests and helps solve issues without unnecessary bureaucracy. Reach out — you'll get real answers, not templates.
About.founderDescription: Responsible for the product, strategy and communication with the audience. WorkZora started with his idea.
About.developerDescription: Builds WorkZora's technical infrastructure — from backend architecture to the client interface.
About.teamP1: WorkZora is not a corporation or another startup with a fancy presentation. It is a product created by two people who decided to make freelancing in Ukraine a little safer. We are a small team, but we listen to feedback, react quickly and stay open to dialogue.
About.teamP2: WorkZora is currently in the MVP stage.
